assertions.assertion: A class implementing IClientStore is created with a constructor accepting IMongoDatabase
assertions.rationale: MongoClientStore implements IClientStore and its constructor takes IMongoDatabase, calling database.GetCollection<ClientDocument>("clients").

assertions.assertion: The FindClientByIdAsync method does NOT include a CancellationToken parameter (v7 target)
assertions.rationale: FindClientByIdAsync(string clientId) has a single parameter and no CancellationToken, matching v7.

assertions.assertion: Registration calls AddClientStore<T> where T is the custom store class
assertions.rationale: Registration chains .AddClientStore<MongoClientStore>() on the AddIdentityServer builder.

assertions.assertion: Registration calls AddInMemoryCaching() and AddClientStoreCache<T>() to wrap the custom store with caching
ClientStoreExpiration is set to TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) or equivalent 5-minute duration
assertions.rationale: options.Caching.ClientStoreExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) is set in the AddIdentityServer options.
